Intel Registration Confirmation
INTEL® ON DEMAND WEB SERVICES
{!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_First_Name__c} {!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_Last_Name__c},
Thank you for requesting access to Intel® On Demand web services testing environment (SBX) . Please allow 3-5 business days for your request to be reviewed.
Once approved, you will receive a confirmation e-mail. Please wait to log in to the Intel® On Demand web services testing environment until AFTER you receive the confirmation email.
Thank you for your patience.
If you have any questions, or do not receive an email regarding your access after one week, please contact us.
Sincerely,
Registration Administrator
Intel® On Demand Team
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response. To ensure that you continue receiving our e-mails, please add us to your address book.
